metadata.title: Systems Biology and Tabular Foundation AI Meta-Analysis of Mycobacterium marinum Response to Simulated Microgravity (NASA OSDR OSD-528)
metadata.description:
This research data package provides a comprehensive, FAIR-compliant systems biology and machine learning meta-analysis centered on NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) study OSD-528 (originally conducted by Clary, Harrison et al., Frontiers in Space Technologies 2022, doi:10.3389/frspt.2022.1032610). The study evaluates the transcriptomic adaptation of biofilm-forming Mycobacterium marinum 1218R exposed to simulated microgravity on hydrophobic polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) silicone membranes across a custom 3D clinostat and a Random Positioning Machine (RPM 2.0) against static 1g ground controls.

We integrate Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA) with the state-of-the-art tabular foundation AI model TabPFN (Hollmann et al., Nature 2025, doi:10.1038/s41586-024-08328-6) to resolve the small-sample spaceflight bottleneck ($N=9$). Note: In this package, computational pipelines are benchmarked against an empirically parameterized synthetic simulation matrix reflecting known M. marinum biology, with companion shell scripts provided for processing the 15 GB raw FASTQ reads from OSDR.
